items.r2_p0: How is your life in Taiwan? It's good! But I have to get up very early. Why? School starts at seven fifty. I go to school at seven thirty, so I get up at six forty-five. Wow! That's early. Do you go to bed early, too? Yes, I go to bed at nine thirty. Great! Early to bed and early to rise. What do you have for breakfast? I usually have a sandwich and some milk. I'm glad you fit in there. Guess what? After lunch, we take a nap at twelve forty. That's interesting. What time do you go home? I go home at four. Oh! It's six thirty now. Time for dinner. We have dumplings for dinner today. I have to go! Love you. Bye! Bye, Mom.
items.early_to_bed_and_early_to_rise: Early to bed and early to rise.
